next.reason: 1985 Segmentation OBJECT-COMPUTER: 'OBJECT-COMPUTER. [computer-name [MEMORY SIZE integer-1 {WORDS|CHARACTERS|MODULES}] [PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1] [SEGMENT-LIMIT IS segment-number] . ]' (§1985:XVI.2.2.2). 2023 keeps computer-name-1, PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1 and the optional closing period (§2023:12.3.6.2; 'the second period in the General format may be omitted', §2023:12.3.6.3 SR4), adds CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION and FOR ALPHANUMERIC/NATIONAL, but has no MEMORY SIZE and no SEGMENT-LIMIT clause. A 1985 program that writes MEMORY SIZE or SEGMENT-LIMIT is refused under 2023 (stricter); a compile-time difference, no exception condition.
